name: Liberty Packaging
old_description: Liberty Packaging is a leading provider of innovative, sustainable packaging products and integrated supply chain solutions.
about:
Liberty Packaging operates from Omaha, Nebraska, as part of the Liberty Diversified International (LDI) family of companies. The business runs an integrated paper mill, Liberty Paper, in Becker, Minnesota, which feeds its packaging plants with 100-percent recycled fiber.

The company produces a range of corrugated packaging products — including partitions, dividers, bulk containers, graphic packaging, retail packaging, e-commerce packaging, and protective packaging — all made from recycled fiber certified to SFI, FSC, and PEFC standards. Its closed-loop recycling system reclaims used boxes to create new paper, and the mill’s location next to Xcel Energy allows reuse of emitted steam in the papermaking process. Beyond manufacturing, Liberty Packaging offers supply-chain services such as design and innovation, warehousing and distribution, kitting and assembly, and end-to-end support across locations in the United States and Mexico.

Liberty Packaging serves customers in sectors that require sustainable packaging and supply-chain solutions, including e-commerce, retail, consumer goods, and industrial markets. Its service models are customized for each client’s space and timing needs.

The company differentiates itself through its circular-economy approach: a fully integrated mill that controls raw material supply, third-party chain-of-custody certifications, and a strategic energy partnership that reduces environmental impact.
